title: Benchmark iroh as IPFS client in a minimal Rust harness
description:
Produce a standalone Rust binary in a scratch workspace that uses iroh to add a 1 KB block, retrieve it by CID, and pin it. Measure add/get latency over 10,000 iterations. Record peak RSS, steady-state RSS, and p99 latency. The artifact is a benchmark binary and a results markdown file.

Acceptance:
- iroh dependency compiles on stable Rust with edition 2021
- Benchmark runs headlessly in CI with cargo bench
- Results file records p50/p99/p999 latency and RSS at steady state
- No panics or IPFS daemon required (embedded node or HTTP API must be documented)
